xmldoc.short_description: Return the number of nonzero elements.

param_input_item.param_description: numeric, logical, or character array, sparse or full.

description.p: nnz returns the number of non zero elements in an matrix.
Dense inputs can be multidimensional. Sparse inputs are 2-D and may store double, single, logical, complex double, or complex single values.
For sparse matrices, nnz counts only values that are actually nonzero. Stored zero values are ignored.

example_item.example_item_data: S = sparse([1 2 1 2], [1 1 2 2], single([0 -0 complex(0, 0) complex(0, 2)]), 2, 2, 4); n = nnz(S)

history_item.history_description: documented sparse single and stored zero behavior
